label: bug
evidence: Dossier nearby() counted gendarmerie and fort rows as military although the rule excludes them from analysis; ui_analysis and ui_hotspots each kept a private regex.
fix: One predicate militaryInAnalysis() used by dossier, analysis and hotspots; test F-D11-1.

label: bug
evidence: gradeClass("Origin note (nearby case CIT)") returned CIT: a parenthetical about another case raised the grade.
fix: Parentheticals stripped before classing; test F-B13-1/2.

label: bug
evidence: "unofficial"/"non-official" grade text matched the Official class.
fix: Negated forms removed before classing; test F-B13-1/2.

label: bug
evidence: Wikidata unknown-value placeholders ("http://www", genid) leaked into 337 shipped rows (313 dissolved/status, 22 inception, 1 country, 1 nuclear summary).
fix: Load-time cleaning in layers.js normItem; builders (wd_mil.py lit(), build_military.py) now write "dissolved (date unknown in Wikidata)"; tests F-D16-1.

label: bug
evidence: CSV export did not quote CR, did not neutralise spreadsheet formulas (OWASP CSV injection) and ui_data kept its own copy of the cell writer.
fix: RFC 4180 csvCell/toCSV with CRLF rows and an apostrophe guard (numbers and BCE dates exempt), shared by every export; test F-B16-1.

label: issue
evidence: Search was case-sensitive to diacritics: "Bacouel" did not find "Bacouël"; omnibox, filter and case search folded differently.
fix: fold() (NFD + strip U+0300-036F) used by prepCases._search, omnibox and st.f.q; test F-G01-1.

label: bug
evidence: Workspace import applied unvalidated JSON to app state; a malformed file threw and the file input was not reset.
fix: sanitizeWorkspace() validates and clamps every field; restoreText() catches errors; localStorage guarded; input reset; test F-B15-1.

label: bug
evidence: Printable dossier called document.write on a null window when pop-ups were blocked (uncaught TypeError, no feedback).
fix: Status message when blocked; w.opener = null.

label: issue
evidence: Stray row("Dataset","") call rendered an empty table row.
fix: Removed.

label: bug
evidence: Reference-layer dossiers (volcanoes, reactors, military, fireballs, GED) showed no coordinate source, against the always-show-coord_source rule.
fix: refHTML always shows a Coord. source row: coord_source, else coord_note, else "As published in the <dataset> dataset".

label: bug
evidence: App uncertainty radii were separate literals in prepCases, markerOf and the layer circles, not tied to the pipeline table build_data.PREC.
fix: DEFAULT_RADIUS_KM + radiusKm() used by prepCases, markerOf and layer circles; test asserts equality with build_data.PREC.

label: issue
evidence: Console and timescale titles called NDAYS "the latest case"; it is a fixed timeline end, not a data fact.
fix: Latest dated case computed from the loaded rows; titles say "end of the timeline"; test F-B11-1 guards that no case falls after NDAYS.

label: issue
evidence: A boot failure (no WebGL, data load error) left a blank page with no message.
fix: bootFailure() markup + #boot-error overlay with a Reload button; test F-H01-1.

label: issue
evidence: Markdown sanitiser lived inside ui_misc.js, untested, with a narrow strip list.
fix: Extracted to src/ui/sanitize.js with more elements and attributes stripped; test F-C04-1.

label: issue
evidence: DBSCAN seed expansion used Array.includes (quadratic on dense clusters).
fix: Set-based expansion, results unchanged; test F-B12-1/2.

label: bug
evidence: weightedSampler with all-zero weights returned an arbitrary index instead of nothing.
fix: Returns null; test F-B12-1/2.

label: bug
evidence: GeoIndex.addSegment indexed antimeridian-crossing segments the long way round (most of the globe).
fix: Short-way indexing; test F-B12-3.

label: issue
evidence: Dead code: hydrolakes "void f" block, feed.js unused tabs, window.js "void kind".
fix: Removed.

label: issue
evidence: toLocaleString() without a locale: number format depended on the browser locale.
fix: en-US passed everywhere.

label: issue
evidence: A first case sort looked lexicographic for BCE rows; a later numeric sort overrode it, so it was redundant dead code.
fix: Removed the redundant sort.

label: bug
evidence: norm_date accepted month 13 / day 45 (rolled into other months), pulled any 3-4 digit run out of ids ("Q836568") and accepted future years from free text.
fix: Month/day validated with leap years (no roll-over); standalone-year rule; future years refused; tests in test/py.

label: dilemma
evidence: 38 date cells are spreadsheet floats ("1723.0") in the vendored QWM snapshot.
fix: Snapshot kept byte-identical to the cited drop; norm_date reads float years; validator warns.

label: error

fix: cff-version 1.2.0, validated against the schema; abstract and keywords updated.

label: issue

label: issue
evidence: CSP allowed services.arcgisonline.com, which no code fetches.
fix: Host removed from img-src and connect-src.

label: issue
evidence: Five target=_blank links had rel="noopener" without noreferrer, leaking the page URL (with case ids) to external hosts.
fix: rel="noopener noreferrer" everywhere; test F-C05-1.

label: issue
evidence: npm audit: moderate advisory in esbuild < 0.25 (dev server request forgery).
fix: esbuild ^0.25.12; npm audit 0 vulnerabilities.

label: issue
evidence: Pipeline passed cmeta between steps as a pickle (unsafe deserialisation, non-reviewable artefact).

label: error
evidence: actionlint/shellcheck: unquoted zip path (SC2086); release, codeql and pages jobs had no timeout.
fix: Path quoted; timeout-minutes on every job.

label: issue

fix: ruff F,E9 clean; npm run test:py and ruff steps in CI; check script runs test:py.

label: error
evidence: Supported-versions table listed 1.0.x.

label: bug

label: bug
evidence: The source date_precision column overrode the parsed precision: GEIPAN-1811 "2000-09-31" (not a calendar date) shipped as day precision.
fix: Precision is the coarser of source and parsed; date_note explains; tests; pass D23.

label: bug
evidence: Spreadsheet float artefacts: 2,454 postal codes as "60120.0" (French codes with leading zero lost, e.g. "8430.0" for 08430) and 1,926 witness_count values as "1.0"; 87 layer count values too.

evidence: Dead branch "if False and ..." in the COW end-date parser.
fix: Removed.

evidence: axe target-size at 1280x800: map tools (#btn-home, #btn-lasso, #btn-grid, #btn-legend) half covered by a window: the charts bottom dock reaching up, the help and briefings modals (probe: elementFromPoint hits #charts, #help, #brief over the buttons).
